name: Princess Shikishi
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 89); Porter gives no dates for this poet.

poems.title: The ailments of advancing years
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 89
poems.text:
The ailments of advancing years
Though I should try to hide,
Some day the thread will break, the pearls
Be scattered far and wide;
Age cannot be defied.

poems.title: 89. 玉の緒よ たえなば絶えね ながらへば (Tama no o yo taenaba taene nagaraeba)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 新古今集
poems.text:
玉の緒よ たえなば絶えね ながらへば
忍ぶることの 弱りもぞする

poems.title: SKKS 3: 山ふかみ春ともしらぬ (Yama fukami haru tomo shiranu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on spring.
poems.text: 山ふかみ春ともしらぬ松のとにたえ／＼かゝる雪のたまみつ

poems.title: SKKS 52: なかめつるけふはむかしに (Nagametsuru kyō wa mukashi ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on spring.
poems.text: なかめつるけふはむかしになりぬとものきはのむめはわれをわするな

poems.title: SKKS 83: いまさくらさきぬと見えて (Ima sakura sakinu to miete)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: いまさくらさきぬと見えてうすくもり春にかすめるよのけしきかな

poems.title: SKKS 101: はかなくてすきにしかたを (Hakanakute sugi ni shikata o)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: はかなくてすきにしかたをかそふれは花にものおもふ春そへにける

poems.title: SKKS 137: やへにほふのきはのさくら (Yae niou nokiba no sakura)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: sent to Prince Koreakira with a branch of the double-flowered cherry from her house.
poems.text: やへにほふのきはのさくらうつろひぬ風よりさきにとふ人もかな

poems.title: SKKS 149: 花はちりその色となく (Hana wa chiri sono iro to naku)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: 花はちりその色となくなかむれはむなしきそらに春雨そふる

poems.title: SKKS 182: わすれめやあふひをくさに (Wasuremeya aoi o kusa ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: composed while she was serving as Kamo Priestess, on the occasion of a rite for the gods.
poems.text: わすれめやあふひをくさにひきむすひかりねのゝへのつゆのあけほの

poems.title: SKKS 215: こゑはしてくもちにむせふ (Koe wa shite kumoji ni musebu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: こゑはしてくもちにむせふほとゝきす涙やそゝくよゐのむらさめ

poems.title: SKKS 240: かへりこぬむかしをいまと (Kaeri konu mukashi o ima to)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on summer.
poems.text: かへりこぬむかしをいまとおもひねの夢の枕にゝほふたちはな

poems.title: SKKS 256: まとちかき竹の葉すさふ (Mado chikaki take no ha susabu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.text: まとちかき竹の葉すさふ風のをとにいとゝみしかきうたゝねの夢

poems.title: SKKS 268: ゆふたちの雲もとまらぬ (Yūdachi no kumo mo tomaranu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: ゆふたちの雲もとまらぬ夏の日のかたふく山にひくらしのこゑ

poems.title: SKKS 277: たそかれのゝきはのおきに (Tasokare no nokiba no ogi ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: たそかれのゝきはのおきにともすれはほにいてぬ秋そしたにことゝふ

poems.title: SKKS 308: うたゝねのあさけのそてに (Utatane no asake no sode ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: うたゝねのあさけのそてにかはるなりならすあふきの秋のはつ風

poems.title: SKKS 321: なかむれは衣手すゝし (Nagamureba koromode suzushi)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: なかむれは衣手すゝしひさかたのあまのかはらの秋のゆふくれ

poems.title: SKKS 349: 花すゝき又つゆふかし (Hana susuki mata tsuyu fukashi)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: 花すゝき又つゆふかしほにいてゝなかめしとおもふ秋のさかりを

poems.title: SKKS 368: それなからむかしにもあらぬ (Sore nagara mukashi ni mo aranu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.text: それなからむかしにもあらぬ秋風にいとゝなかめをしつのをたまき

poems.title: SKKS 380: なかめわひぬ秋よりほかの (Nagamewabinu aki yori hoka no)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.text: なかめわひぬ秋よりほかのやともかな野にも山にも月やすむらん

poems.title: SKKS 416: よゐのまにさてもねぬへき (Yoi no ma ni sate mo nubeki)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.text: よゐのまにさてもねぬへき月ならは山の葉ちかきものはおもはし

poems.title: SKKS 432: 秋の色はまかきにうとく (Aki no iro wa magaki ni utoku)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on autumn.
poems.text: 秋の色はまかきにうとくなりゆけとたまくらなるゝねやの月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 474: あともなき庭のあさちに (Ato mo naki niwa no asaji ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: あともなき庭のあさちにむすほゝれつゆのそこなる松むしのこゑ

poems.title: SKKS 484: ちたひうつきぬたのをとに (Chitabi utsu kinuta no oto ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.text: ちたひうつきぬたのをとに夢さめてものおもふ袖のつゆそくたくる

poems.title: SKKS 534: きりの葉もふみわけかたく (Kiri no ha mo fumiwake-gataku)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on autumn.
poems.text: きりの葉もふみわけかたくなりにけりかならす人をまつとなけれと

poems.title: SKKS 605: 風さむみ木の葉はれゆく (Kaze samumi ko no ha hareyuku)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: no set topic.
poems.text: 風さむみ木の葉はれゆくよな／＼にのこるくまなき庭の月かけ

poems.title: SKKS 638: 見るまゝに冬はきにけり (Miru mama ni fuyu wa kinikeri)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: 見るまゝに冬はきにけりかものゐるいりえのみきはうすこほりつゝ

poems.title: SKKS 662: さむしろのよはの衣手 (Samushiro no yowa no koromode)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: さむしろのよはの衣手さえ／＼てはつ雪しろしをかのへの松

poems.title: SKKS 690: ひかすふる雪けにまさる (Hikazu furu yuki ke ni masaru)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: ひかすふる雪けにまさるすみかまのけふりもさむし大原のさと

poems.title: SKKS 734: あめのしためくむくさ木の (Ame no shita megumu kusaki no)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: あめのしためくむくさ木のめもはるにかきりもしらぬみよのすゑ／＼

poems.title: SKKS 947: ゆくすゑはいまいくよとか (Yukusue wa ima ikuyo to ka)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: ゆくすゑはいまいくよとかいはしろのをかのかやねにまくらむすはん

poems.title: SKKS 1074: しるへせよあとなきなみに (Shirube seyo ato naki nami ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: no set topic.
poems.text: しるへせよあとなきなみにこく舟のゆくゑもしらぬやへのしほ風

poems.title: SKKS 1124: 夢にても見ゆらんものを (Yume ni te mo miyuran mono o)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: 夢にても見ゆらんものをなけきつゝうちぬるよゐの袖のけしきは

poems.title: SKKS 1153: あふことをけふまつかえの (Au koto o kyō matsukae no)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: あふことをけふまつかえのたむけ草いくよしほるゝそてとかはしる

poems.title: SKKS 1204: 君まつとねやへもいらぬ (Kimi matsu to neya e mo iranu)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: on the theme of waiting for a lover.
poems.text: 君まつとねやへもいらぬまきのとにいたくなふけそ山の葉の月

poems.title: SKKS 1309: いまはたゝ心のほかに (Ima wa tada kokoro no hoka ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: no set topic.
poems.text: いまはたゝ心のほかにきく物をしらすかほなるおきのうは風

poems.title: SKKS 1328: さりともとまちし月日そ (Sari tomo to machishi tsukihi zo)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: さりともとまちし月日そうつりゆく心の花の色にまかせて

poems.title: SKKS 1392: はかなくそしらぬいのちを (Hakanaku zo shiranu inochi o)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: composed as a love poem.
poems.text: はかなくそしらぬいのちをなけきこしわかゝねことのかゝりけるよに

poems.title: SKKS 1486: ほとゝきすそのかみ山の (Hototogisu sono kamiyama no)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: recalling her years as Kamo Priestess.
poems.text: ほとゝきすそのかみ山のたひ枕ほのかたらひしそらそわすれぬ

poems.title: SKKS 1546: ありあけのおなしなかめは (Ariake no onaji nagame wa)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: a reply to the preceding poem (by Prince Koreakira).
poems.text: ありあけのおなしなかめはきみもとへみやこのほかも秋の山さと

poems.title: SKKS 1665: いまはわれ松のはしらの (Ima wa ware matsu no hashira no)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court, on the theme of a mountain dwelling.
poems.text: いまはわれ松のはしらのすきのいほにとつへき物をこけふかき袖

poems.title: SKKS 1672: おのゝえのくちしむかしは (Ono no e no kuchishi mukashi wa)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence, composed after the death of the retired emperor Go-Shirakawa.
poems.text: おのゝえのくちしむかしはとをけれとありしにもあらぬよをもふる哉

poems.title: SKKS 1810: あか月のゆふつけとりそ (Akatsuki no yūtsuke-dori zo)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: あか月のゆふつけとりそ哀なるなかきねふりをおもふ枕に

poems.title: SKKS 1847: くるゝまもまつへきよかは (Kururu ma mo matsubeki yo ka wa)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence presented to the court.
poems.text: くるゝまもまつへきよかはあたしのゝすゑはのつゆに嵐たつ也

poems.title: SKKS 1969: しつかなるあか月ことに (Shizuka naru akatsuki goto ni)
poems.author: Princess Shikishi
poems.note: Headnote: from a hundred-poem sequence, on the theme of entering meditation each day at dawn.
poems.text: しつかなるあか月ことに見わたせはまたふかきよの夢そかなしき
